integrity.source_model: Nugent, Gomes and Wolfram, arXiv:2305.09483v1, equations (3), (8), (12)
integrity.verification: self-contained Python3 numerical and differential-identity checks; finite checks are not universal proofs

scientific_limitations: Symmetric deterministic two-agent reduction only; initial weights strictly between zero and one, initial opinions distinct and in [-1,1].
Exponential receptiveness and the original unit-rate logistic tie evolution are essential; larger, directed, stochastic and differently normalized models are not covered.
Independent scientific audit and exhaustive publication-priority determination have not been performed.
title: A sharp tie-strength separatrix and critical slowing in two-agent adaptive opinion dynamics
